sloka: प्रतीक्षमाणो अभिजनम् तदा आर्तम् ।अनार्त रूपः प्रहसन्न् इव अथ।जगाम रामः पितरम् दिदृक्षुः ।पितुर् निदेशम् विधिवच् चिकीर्षुः ॥२-३३-२९॥
transliteration: pratīkṣamāṇo abhijanam tadā ārtam ।anārta rūpaḥ prahasann iva atha।jagāma rāmaḥ pitaram didṛkṣuḥ ।pitur nideśam vidhivac cikīrṣuḥ ॥2-33-29॥

translations.english: Even after observing the people in grief, Rama did not reveal his sorrowful feelings. Bound by duty he went in as if with a smile to see his father.
